macros.name: addthumb
macros.doc: The \addthumb command has four parameters: 1. a title for the thumb mark (for the thumb marks overview page, e. g. the chapter title), 2. the text to be displayed in the thumb mark (for example a chapter number), 3. the colour of the text in the thumb mark, 4. and the background colour of the thumb mark (parameters in this order).

macros.name: continuethumb
macros.doc: \continuethumb continues the issuing of thumb marks (equal to the one before this was stopped by \stopthumb).

macros.name: stopthumb
macros.doc: When a page (or pages) shall have no thumb marks, use the \stopthumb command (without parameters).

macros.name: thumbnewcolumn
macros.doc: With the command \thumbnewcolumn a new column can be started, even if the current one was not filled.

macros.name: thumbsnophantom
macros.doc: To locally disable the setting of a \phantomsection before a thumb mark, the command \thumbsnophantom is provided.

macros.name: thumbsoverview
macros.doc: The commands \thumbsoverview, \thumbsoverviewback, \thumbsoverviewverso, and/or \thumbsoverviewdouble is/are used to place the overview page(s) for the thumb marks (edge index).
